source_name: Registro Estatal de Centros Docentes no Universitarios (RCD) - Ministerio de Educación
what_it_contains: All authorised non-university schools in Spain incl. Escuelas de Educación Infantil (first cycle 0-3 and second cycle 3-6): name, código de centro, address, phone, titularidad (público/privado/concertado), teachings offered.
how_to_extract: Search by comunidad, provincia, 'Naturaleza: Privado' and 'Enseñanza: Educación Infantil (primer ciclo)'; export results per province; group by titular/owner name to detect chains (same titular across many códigos).

source_name: Comunidad de Madrid - Buscador de centros educativos
what_it_contains: Madrid region schools incl. private 0-3 escuelas infantiles with address, phone, email, titular and website.
how_to_extract: Filter Tipo de centro = Escuela de Educación Infantil, Titularidad = Privado; scrape listing pages or use datos.comunidad.madrid open-data CSV 'Centros educativos'.

source_name: Ayuntamiento de Madrid open data - Escuelas infantiles municipales: empresas gestoras
what_it_contains: List of municipal escuelas infantiles in Madrid city with the private company/cooperative managing each under concession.
how_to_extract: Download CSV/XLS; pivot by 'empresa gestora' to rank concession operators (Clece/Koala, Arasti Barca, Suara etc.) and count centres per operator.

source_name: Generalitat de Catalunya - Mapa escolar / Cercador de centres educatius
what_it_contains: All Catalan llars d'infants / escoles bressol (public and private) with codes, addresses, titularity.
how_to_extract: Filter 'Ensenyament: Educació infantil primer cicle'; export; cross-reference municipal ones with ajuntament tender records to identify gestoras.

source_name: Junta de Andalucía - Centros de infantil 0-3 años (Agencia Pública Andaluza de Educación)
what_it_contains: Directory of adhered/authorised 0-3 centres in Andalusia (public and private conveniados), with titular details.
how_to_extract: Use the consulta de centros; download lists per province; group by titular entity.

source_name: Franchise directories (mundofranquicia, franquiciashoy, quefranquicia, infofranquicias)
what_it_contains: Profiles of escuela-infantil franchise brands with number of units, founding year, franchisor company and contact.
how_to_extract: Scrape category pages; collect brand, units, franchisor S.L.; enrich company via einforma/iberinform (administrator names, CIF).

source_name: Carta Social (GEP / Ministério do Trabalho, Solidariedade e Segurança Social)
what_it_contains: Every social response in Portugal incl. Creche and Pré-escolar (IPSS, private, public): entity, capacity, address, contacts.
how_to_extract: Use 'Pesquisa de respostas sociais' with resposta = Creche; export by distrito; group by entidade proprietária to find multi-site IPSS and private groups.

source_name: DGEEC - Direção-Geral de Estatísticas da Educação e Ciência (Rede escolar / Estatísticas da Educação)
what_it_contains: Statistics and lists of pré-escolar establishments (public, private, IPSS) with enrolment; 'Rede escolar' database of schools.
how_to_extract: Download 'Perfil do Aluno'/'Educação em Números' and the school database (Estabelecimentos de ensino) as Excel; filter nível = pré-escolar and natureza = privado.

source_name: Segurança Social - Lista de creches Creche Feliz / Creche gratuita
what_it_contains: Creches with cooperation agreements participating in free-creche programme, by municipality and entity.
how_to_extract: Download PDF/Excel lists per distrito and consolidate by entity.

source_name: MIUR / MIM - Scuola in Chiaro
what_it_contains: All state and paritarie scuole dell'infanzia (3-6) with codice meccanografico, address, gestore (for paritarie), email/PEC.
how_to_extract: Use open data 'Anagrafe scuole paritarie' CSV at dati.istruzione.it; filter tipologia = scuola dell'infanzia; group by gestore/ente to identify multi-site operators.

source_name: ISTAT - Nidi e servizi integrativi per la prima infanzia
what_it_contains: Annual census of nidi (public and private) by municipality: number of units, places, gestione diretta vs affidata, spesa.
how_to_extract: Download I.Stat tables 'Servizi socio-educativi per la prima infanzia'; use to size markets and find municipalities with high outsourcing.

source_name: Anagrafe nazionale dei servizi educativi per l'infanzia (Sistema integrato 0-6, Ministero dell'Istruzione)
what_it_contains: National registry (in progress) of 0-3 nidi and sezioni primavera with gestore; regional registries (e.g. Emilia-Romagna 'SPI-ER', Lombardia 'AFAM', Toscana 'SIRI') list authorised nidi with managing entity.
how_to_extract: Query regional open-data portals (dati.emilia-romagna.it, dati.lombardia.it, dati.toscana.it) for 'servizi educativi prima infanzia'; group by soggetto gestore.

source_name: Albo cooperative / Registro Imprese (Infocamere) ATECO 88.91 & 85.10
what_it_contains: Company registry entries for social cooperatives and companies in childcare (88.91) and pre-primary education (85.10) with legal representatives and turnover.
how_to_extract: Search by ATECO code and region; buy visure or use AIDA/Cerved exports for revenue ranking of operators.

source_name: Ministry of Education (ΥΠΑΙΘΑ) - Registry of private nipiagogeia & school search
what_it_contains: Licensed private nipiagogeia and schools; regional directorates publish lists of private units.
how_to_extract: Request/scrape the 'Μητρώο ιδιωτικών σχολείων' lists per Regional Directorate; filter nipiagogeia; match to operators.

source_name: Ministry of Interior / Municipalities - Paidikoi Stathmoi (0-4) licences and EETAA voucher programme
what_it_contains: EETAA 'Εναρμόνιση Οικογενειακής και Επαγγελματικής Ζωής' publishes yearly lists of all participating public and private paidikoi stathmoi with capacity and operator.
how_to_extract: Download annual 'Πίνακας δομών' Excel from eetaa.gr; group private structures by operator/company name to identify chains.

source_name: GEMI (General Commercial Registry)
what_it_contains: Company data (legal reps) for private paidikoi stathmoi companies.
how_to_extract: Search by activity code 88.91 / 85.10 and company name.

source_name: Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth - Registry of private nursery schools and kindergartens
what_it_contains: Lists of registered private nipiagogeia/kindergartens (Δημοτική Εκπαίδευση - Ιδιωτικά Νηπιαγωγεία) by district.
how_to_extract: Download the Ιδιωτικά Νηπιαγωγεία list (PDF) per district; consolidate; cross-check with Social Welfare Services list of registered day-care centres (βρεφοπαιδοκομικοί σταθμοί).

source_name: Social Welfare Services (Deputy Ministry of Social Welfare) - Registered childcare centres
what_it_contains: Registered day-care centres for 0-4 (public, community, private).
how_to_extract: Request/scrape the list; match operators.

source_name: Ministry for Education - Registered Childcare Centres / Free Childcare Scheme list
what_it_contains: All licensed childcare centres (0-3) in Malta and Gozo, and those on the Free Childcare Scheme, with address and operator.
how_to_extract: Download the registered centres PDF; consolidate; identify operators with several licences.

source_name: Malta Business Registry
what_it_contains: Company officers for childcare operating companies.
how_to_extract: Search by company name from the licence list.

source_name: Eurydice - Early Childhood Education and Care country reports
what_it_contains: Structure of ECEC systems, governance and private-sector share per country.
how_to_extract: Read country chapters 4.x to understand which authority licenses 0-3 vs 3-6 and where registries live.
